NAME:
   rancher support-bundle - Collect diagnostics reachable through the API into one tar.gz for support

USAGE:
   rancher support-bundle [flags]

FLAGS:
   --clusters string   downstream cluster ids/names to include (comma-separated)
   --help, -h          show help
   --output-file file  write the tar.gz archive to a new file; an existing file or - is refused
   --since duration    collect logs newer than this duration (default 24h)
   --tail lines        max log lines per target (default 10000)
   --targets targets   comma-separated log targets (server, agent, fleet-agent, kube-api-auth, webhook, api-extension), or all (the default)

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
